name: MR-fluid platform
full_name: Southeast University / Kagawa MR-fluid haptic robotic platform with force sensing and guidewire-catheter collaborative operation
group: Southeast University, State Key Laboratory of Digital Medical Engineering (Aiguo Song; Xiaoliang Jin) with Kagawa University (Shuxiang Guo); Zhuhai Hanglok Medical Technology co-author on the 2025 follow-up
versions: jin2024_novel (T-IM 2024, received Mar 2023) -> jin2025_natural (T-HMS 2025: leader device with haptic feedback; abstract not read)
target_anatomy: vessel model; endovascular evaluator (EVE) model at 120/80 mmHg
devices_driven: guidewire and catheter (guidewire unit GMU, catheter unit CMU)
rotation_detail: Synchronous-belt rotation of the grasper (pulley diameter 46.3 mm; belt also used for linear motion)
footprint_mm: rail with ruler in Fig. 6 photo; size N.R.
force_sensing: Total proximal force by TEAC TU-UJ5N load cell (-5 to 5 N) on a lead screw behind the grasper (spring-loaded slider moves slightly under load); torque by torque sensor during rotation; load cell reads positive for guidewire insertion
haptics_leader: MR-fluid haptic leader: two coils (30 mm inner, 120 mm outer diameter, 1200 turns); haptic force rises with current over 0-0.6 A (about 0.4 to 2.1 N, read from the Fig. 5 plot)
sterility: N.R.; grasper contact blocks are rubber-faced and opened by hollow steppers
validation_detail: Vessel model and EVE endovascular evaluator; sample counts N.R. in the sections read
key_numbers: Load cell +/-5 N; stepper 0.36 deg resolution; haptic force 0.4-2.1 N for 0-0.6 A (plot reading)
